ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark pigmentation (~70%) with distinct high-intensity white regions (~30%) concentrated in the distal sections of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe contains an irregular high-intensity patch centered at approximately x=20%, y=30% of the visible surface. Right lobe contains a larger triangular high-intensity region at the distal tip (x=80-95%). The central corridor and lower fluke margins are solid low-intensity pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 62 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 18% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern along the continuous trailing edge; amplitude peaks at 5-10 pixels. Most prominent irregularities are located on the medial sections of both lobes flanking the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep along the trailing boundary, tapering to sharp distal points heavily modified by surface accumulation.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast pixel groups located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, measuring approximately 50x70 pixels on the left and 60x80 on the right.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel linear disruptions (rake-like marks) visible in the dark pigmented region of the upper-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at both fluke tips causing significant alteration of the natural geometric edge; three distinct irregular nicks present on the trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced 'splatter' mottling at the transition boundaries between white and black pixel regions, specifically on the medial-distal transition of the right lobe.
